British Museum Bans Bayeux Tapestry Photos to Ease Crowds

The British Museum has banned photography of the Bayeux Tapestry to help manage visitor flow and reduce queues. The decision was prompted by a surge in visitor interest, described as a "craze," which led to congestion around the exhibit.
